lines: 带耶稣去的时候，有一个古利奈人西门，
从乡下来；他们就抓住他，
把十字架搁在他身上，
叫他背着跟随耶稣。
When they led him away
they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene
coming from the country
and laid on him the cross
to carry it after Jesus.

they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene
coming from the country
and laid on him the cross
to carry it after Jesus.
And while they were taking him away
they put their hands on Simon of Cyrene
who was coming from the country
and made him take the cross after Jesus.
